title: NYC Daily Digest
text:
☀️ Good morning, Matthew! It's Sunday, November 8, 2026.

🌤️ Weather
Bright, breezy and mild, with a high near 60–62°F. I couldn't find a reliable current temperature or overnight low; expect a chilly start and a cool evening, probably in the 40s. Little to no rain expected today, and the rain holds off until late in the week (Thu–Fri).
What to wear: a light jacket or layers, plus sunglasses. Leave the umbrella at home today.

🗞️ Headlines
• Midterms: Democrats won both chambers. AP's Saturday tally is 254 House seats and 54 in the Senate, with some races (MS and AK Senate) still uncalled.
• Israel: President Herzog is set to task Gadi Eisenkot with forming a new government today, after neither he nor Netanyahu won a majority.
• Iran: The U.S. military says a strike disabled a ship trying to run the blockade on Iran. There are also reports of mines hitting two tankers.
• DOJ: Judge Ana Reyes plans to appoint a special master to look into whether DOJ officials misled her about Trump's East Potomac golf course project.
• NYC: A federal judge ordered the Mamdani administration to comply with an ICE subpoena for data on a Mott Haven shelter. City Hall is "evaluating next steps."

🚇 Getting around (weekend work, check mta.info before you go)
• A train: No service between Rockaway Blvd and Ozone Park–Lefferts Blvd. Lefferts-bound trains run to Howard Beach–JFK instead, through early Nov 16.
• 1 train: No service between Van Cortlandt Park–242 St and Dyckman St until 5 a.m. Monday.
• J and M: No service between Myrtle Av (Broadway) and Manhattan this weekend because of switch work.

🎉 NYC today
• The New York Comedy Festival is in full swing (Nov 6–15), with shows all over the city tonight.
• Bryant Park's Winter Village is open, so it's a good sunny-Sunday skate or market stroll.

💡 Nugget
We're a week past the end of Daylight Saving Time, and sunset is now around 4:40 p.m. Plan any outdoor time for early afternoon to make the most of today's sun.
